messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV-cache eviction rate > 5k/s on tp-shard-07; multiple NCCL timeout traces detected. paging_thresholds breached. Auto-escalation to #incidents triggered.
lia: ack — I'm oncall. can someone share which models / customers are impacted?
shawn: seeing sustained continuous-batching queue growth starting ~1928999000, token throughput doubled then lat spikes. likely KV cache blowout + uneven shard placement.
zoe: @lia rough impact: three customers in Dedicated (AcmeCorp, BrightPay, Marketly) saw 5%-20% request failures and elevated latencies. Hosted traffic had retries but no hard errors.
mike: logs from tp-shard-07:```[2026-08-14T03:20:11Z] NCCL ERROR :: NCCL_TIMEOUT: nccclCommAllReduce loop stall
stack: ncclCommAllReduce -> allreduce_loop -> sync_kernel -> ----------------``` repeated across GPUs. Also OOM-ish eviction messages: "kv_cache: evicting 12000 entries in 60s"
iris: paging metrics: ssd-paging spikes at 85% of capacity, pagein lat 40-80ms. continuous-batching window grew from 8->64 requests per batch.
lia: ok immediate plan: 1) throttle continuous batching (set max_batch_tokens=2048) 2) disable KV prefetch/prefix caching on affected shards 3) re-route critical customer traffic to fallback region. who can run the hotfix?
shawn: I can push the batch config hotfix and restart the tp pods in a controlled canary. will run on tp-shard-07 first.
zoe: I'll open a support banner for AcmeCorp + notify CSMs. putting customer-impact doc in the thread.
lia: assign incident lead to shawn; SRE support: @eng-sre please assist with NCCL restart ordering to avoid cross-shard rebalance storms.
eng-sre: standing by. recommend sequence: disable batching -> drain traffic -> bounce GPUs sequentially with 30s gap -> monitor NCCL errors.
shawn: applying config now:```curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/configs/tp-shard-07 -d '{"continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens":2048, "kv_cache.prefetch":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
shawn: rolling restart of tp-shard-07 replica 2 -> 3 -> 1 to minimize allreduce overlap. kicking off at 1929002000.
lia: switching critical customer routes: AcmeCorp -> region-eu-fallback, BrightPay -> dedicated-reserve-3.
mike: after config change we see eviction rate drop ~72% within 90s. NCCL timeout traces decreased but one GPU still showing sporadic stalls.
zoe: CSMs notified, sent estimated recovery ETA 20-30m. AcmeCorp flagged as high impact; we offered socket-level retries and temporary routing.
shawn: discovered shard partition map was skewed: tp-shard-07 had 3x the KV partitions for hot keys due to hashing change deployed earlier today. pushing quick balancing patch to control-plane:```PATCH /api/shard-mapper/redistribute {"shard":"tp-shard-07","strategy":"consistent-rehash","seed":"20260814-hotfix"}```
iris: note: patch will reassign partitions which triggers background migration. recommend throttle migrations to 50rps to avoid paging spikes.
eng-sre: started controlled partition rebalance at 1929003200 with migration throttle. monitoring SSD page-ins.
mike: migration started, paging dropped from 85%->60% within 6 minutes. continuous-batching queue returned to normal sizes.
lia: good. any regression windows or customer errors still open?
zoe: AcmeCorp still seeing rare 5xxs for long tail requests that hit the hot partition; routing + retry mitigated 90% of requests. BrightPay fully recovered.
shawn: will run full KV integrity check on tp-shard-07 after migration completes. also adding a temporary safety: if eviction_rate > 2000/s auto-disable continuous-batching for that shard.
lia: approved. shawn, eng-sre, mike — please add short runbook entry for this sequence. I'll keep this incident open until postmortem created and follow-ups assigned.
eng-sre: capturing metrics and logs to incident archive: https://grafana.redwood/incident/1929001234 (link) — dashboards: kv_evictions, nccL_timeouts, ssd_paging, batch_queue_size.
shawn: migration finished at 1929004900, KV partition distribution normalized. ran quick integration tests; no more NCCL timeouts reproduced.
mike: post-action checks: 1) eviction_rate stable < 400/s 2) ssd paging < 30% 3) average p99 latency back to baseline. all green.
lia: incident -> status: mitigated. customer impact: AcmeCorp partial (5% errors for 15 minutes), BrightPay minor, Marketly degraded but auto-recovered.
zoe: CSMs will follow up with official incident summary and timeline to AcmeCorp.
lia: follow-ups assigned: shawn -> permanent shard-hash-fix and canary; eng-sre -> automated circuit to disable continuous-batching on threshold; mike -> refine paging thresholds and add alert on uneven partition distribution; iris -> perf test replay for hot-key distribution. ETA 7 days for fixes.
shawn: creating postmortem stub now, will include root cause: hashing change + continuous-batching growth -> KV blowout -> paging -> NCCL stalls during collective ops.
lia: thanks team. closing oncall handoff in 10m unless new regressions. please drop any lingering logs or commands in this thread. :thumbsup:
